mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.board_id, p.title, p.content, p.like_count, p.created_at, p.updated_at, u.id AS author_id, u.username AS author_username, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.avatar AS author_avatar, (pl.status IS NOT NULL) AS liked FROM post p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN post_likes pl ON pl.post_id = p.id AND pl.user_id = #{currentUserId} AND pl.status = 1 WHERE p.board_id = #{boardId} AND p.status = 0 ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT p.id, p.board_id, p.title, p.content, p.like_count, p.created_at, p.updated_at, u.id AS author_id, u.username AS author_username, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.avatar AS author_avatar, (pl.status IS NOT NULL) AS liked FROM post p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN post_likes pl ON pl.post_id = p.id AND pl.user_id = #{currentUserId} AND pl.status = 1 WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND p.status = 0 ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT p.id, p.board_id, p.title, p.content, p.like_count, p.created_at, p.updated_at, u.id AS author_id, u.username AS author_username, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.avatar AS author_avatar, (pl.status IS NOT NULL) AS liked FROM post p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN post_likes pl ON pl.post_id = p.id AND pl.user_id = #{currentUserId} AND pl.status = 1 WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.status = 0

SELECT p.id, p.board_id, b.name AS board_name, p.title, p.content, p.like_count, p.created_at, p.updated_at, u.id AS author_id, u.username AS author_username, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.avatar AS author_avatar, (pl.status IS NOT NULL) AS liked FROM post p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id JOIN boards b ON b.id = p.board_id LEFT JOIN post_likes pl ON pl.post_id = p.id AND pl.user_id = #{currentUserId} AND pl.status = 1 WHERE p.status = 0 AND (p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post WHERE status = 0 AND (title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
